The data is scattered and nobody trusts it. So we won't just answer it once. We'll build it, catalog it, publish it, then ask.
Five minutes. Source to insights. Go.
Nice pace. Data nobody can find is data nobody uses. Keep going.
We built it once, catalogued it and published it. Next month, anyone can ask, and get a trusted answer in seconds.
Good data in. Good answers out. That's a data foundation.
